extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and prospective authors/attendees of OSDI '25 (systems researchers, paper/artifact authors, and conference participants)
extracted.subtask_description: Conference information for OSDI '25 with cues about what kinds of work the symposium values (and some procedural policies affecting authors/presenters). Useful for authors preparing submissions, artifacts, slides, and accommodation requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Symposium emphasis: innovative research and quantified/insightful experiences
rubrics_metrics.description: The symposium emphasizes innovative research as well as quantified or insightful experiences in systems design and implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target work should focus on the design, implementation, and implications of systems software; valued contributions include both novel research and experience papers that provide quantified or insightful lessons. (The page does not provide an explicit scoring rubric or further submission criteria; authors should interpret acceptance priorities as favoring innovation and rigorous/insightful empirical evidence.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Artifact evaluation (presence of Artifact Evaluation Committee)
rubrics_metrics.description: Artifact Evaluation Committee (co-chairs and committee members listed), indicating that artifacts associated with papers are evaluated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists an Artifact Evaluation Committee and members but gives no artifact-evaluation criteria on this page. Implication for authors: artifacts may be expected and will be reviewed by a dedicated committee — consult separate artifact guidelines (not present here) for submission/evaluation rules and scoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open-access policy for proceedings and slides
rubrics_metrics.description: As part of our commitment to open access to research, the full proceedings and presentation slides are free and open to the public on the technical sessions page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should expect accepted papers and slides to be publicly available; prepare materials accordingly (no private/embargoed distribution implied). No additional licensing or formatting rules are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility accommodation request deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: To ensure that we meet your needs, please make your request by Monday, June 16. We cannot guarantee that we can meet requests received after this date, although we will make every reasonable effort to do so.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presenters/attendees who require ADA or other accommodations (e.g., mothers' rooms) must request them by the stated deadline; this is a procedural requirement affecting presenters' ability to participate fully.
